name: type
label: Type
description: Type determines the display view of the date-range-picker.

name: end
label: End
description: Date string for ending of the range that matches the passed in `format`

name: requireConfirmation
label: Require Confirmation
description: Toggles whether or not to show the Ok and Cancel buttons.

name: format
label: Format
description: Date format for the date string.

name: hasTime
label: Has Time
description: When true, enables selecting a time range.

name: isoWeek
label: ISO Week
description: Toggles whether to use Leap Week with 53 weeks as needed for Weekly View Only (type : `weekly`)

name: labelStart
label: Label Start
description: Label for the Start field that is shown to the user.

name: labelEnd
label: Label End
description: Label for the End field that is shown to the user.

name: language
label: Language
description: String that defines the user's language and region.

name: preset
label: Preset
description: The preset from `presets` to initially use.

name: presets
label: Presets
description: Presets to display as selected range.

name: showAdjacentMonthDays
label: Show Adjacent Month Days
description: Decide whether to show adjacent month days or not in the grid

name: start
label: Start
description: Date string for starting of the range that matches the passed in `format`

name: timeAgo
label: Time Ago
description: Toggles whether or not to show the TimeAgo Preset Panel for Standard View Only (type : `standard`)

name: readonly
label: Read only
description: Specifies that the user cannot modify the value of the component

name: reversed
label: Reversed
description: When true, enables Right to Left behavior (RTL)
